title: STUN-Bench: Truly Unseen Tools for Evaluating Shared Tool Experience
abstract: arXiv:2611.30034v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A tool router retrieves a few candidate tools per request and lets a language model choose. Methods that share experience across organizations add past requests about each tool to what the router retrieves. StableToolBench calls some of its test groups tests on "unseen" tools, yet the ToolBench instruction pool, which retrievers and experience-sharing methods learn from, contains every test query and labels every gold tool of the two single-tool groups among them. We release STUN-Bench (StableToolBench, Truly UNseen), a split whose experience pool has no item that labels or names 172 held-out tools. Unseen here means absent from shared experience and retriever training data, not from pretraining. On the split we find crowding: experience pooled from five simulated clients, added to an index of tool descriptions, outranks the descriptions of tools no client has used, which then often drop out of the candidate list. translated_title: STUN-Bench：用于评估共享工具经验的真正未见工具基准
translated_abstract: 工具路由器为每个请求检索少量候选工具，并让语言模型进行选择。跨组织共享经验的方法会将关于每个工具的历史请求添加到路由器检索的内容中。StableToolBench 将其中某些测试组称为对“未见”工具的测试，然而检索器和经验共享方法从中学习的 ToolBench 指令池，却包含了这两个单工具测试组中的每一个测试查询，并标记了其中所有的黄金工具。我们发布了 STUN-Bench（StableToolBench, Truly UNseen），这是一个新的数据分割，其经验池中不存在任何标记或命名172个保留工具的条目。这里的“未见”指的是在共享经验和检索器训练数据中缺失，而非在预训练数据中缺失。在该分割数据集上，我们发现了“拥挤”现象：从五个模拟客户端汇集的经验被添加到工具描述索引后，其排名超过了没有任何客户端使用过的工具的描述，导致这些工具经常从候选列表中被淘汰。在 Jina-v2 检索器下……
tldr: 该论文提出STUN-Bench基准，构建了经验池中完全不包含172个保留工具任何信息的数据分割，并揭示了共享经验会挤占工具描述排名、导致真正未见的工具从候选列表中消失的“拥挤”问题。
en_tdlr: STUN-Bench is a benchmark whose experience pool contains no items labeling or naming 172 held-out tools, revealing a crowding problem where pooled shared experience outranks tool descriptions and causes truly unseen tools to drop out of candidate lists.
